f4.a: Some cover starts right away, and some after a short waiting period. It is written clearly on each plan page.
f5.a: Each plan lists its exclusions in plain words. If something is unclear, ask us before you buy.

f7.a: Cancel from your account or by phone. Cover runs until the end of the paid month, and refunds follow the terms.
